title: Addition of rational numbers
competency: Add rational numbers and use the properties of addition.

keywords.def: A denominator shared by two or more fractions.
Changing the order does not change the answer: a + b = b + a.
Changing the grouping does not change the answer: (a + b) + c = a + (b + c).

en.text: To add fractions with the same denominator, add the numerators and keep the denominator. 5/8 + 2/8 = 7/8. On a number line, adding a positive moves right and adding a negative moves left.

am.text: ተመሳሳይ ተካፋይ ያላቸውን ክፍልፋዮች ለመደመር ላዕላዮቹን ደምርና ተካፋዩን አቆይ። 5/8 + 2/8 = 7/8።

screens.ask: Start at 0. Tap Hop for each number. Where do you land?
screens.after:
Hop 1: +6 means 6 steps to the right. You land on 6.
Hop 2: −3 means 3 steps to the left. You land on 3.
So 6 + (−3) = 3. Adding a negative number moves left.
screens.intro: Start at 0. A positive number hops right; a negative number hops left.

screens.title: −9 + 5 on the number line
screens.ask: Start at 0. Hop 1 is −9: 9 steps left. Hop 2 is +5: 5 steps right. Tap Hop twice.
screens.after:
Hop 1: −9 means 9 steps to the left. From 0 you land on −9.
Hop 2: +5 means 5 steps to the right. From −9 you land on −4.
So −9 + 5 = −4.
Check: 9 is bigger than 5, so the answer is negative: 9 − 5 = 4, so −4.
screens.intro: Start at 0. Negative numbers hop left, positive numbers hop right.

screens.title: Same denominators
paras: To add fractions with the same denominator, add the numerators.
Keep the common denominator: a/b + c/b = (a + c)/b.

screens.ask: Add fractions with the same denominator: 3/5 + 6/5 = ___
screens.why:
The denominators are the same: 5.
Add the numerators: 3 + 6 = 9.
Keep the denominator: 9/5.
9/5 = 1 4/5. (Do not add the bottoms: 10 would be wrong.)

screens.ask: Add fractions with the same denominator (one is negative): −3/4 + 11/4 = ___
screens.why:
The denominators are the same: 4.
Add the numerators: −3 + 11 = 8.
So the sum is 8/4.
8 ÷ 4 = 2. Answer: 2.
screens.worked:
Same denominator 4, so add the tops: −3 + 11 = 8.
The sum is 8/4.
8/4 = 8 ÷ 4 = 2.

screens.ask: Add three fractions with the same denominator: 8/7 + 5/7 + 6/7 = ___
screens.why:
All denominators are 7.
Add the numerators: 8 + 5 + 6 = 19.
Keep the denominator: 19/7.
19/7 = 2 5/7 (19 ÷ 7 = 2 remainder 5).

screens.ask: Add three fractions with the same denominator: −5/9 + 2/9 + 8/9 = ___
screens.why:
All denominators are 9.
Add the numerators: −5 + 2 = −3, then −3 + 8 = 5.
Keep the denominator: 5/9.
Answer: 5/9.

en.text: When denominators differ, find their LCM. Rewrite each fraction with the LCM as the denominator. Then add the numerators. Always reduce the answer.

am.text: ተካፋዮቹ የተለያዩ ሲሆኑ ትንሹን የጋራ ብዜት ፈልግ። እያንዳንዱን ክፍልፋይ በዚያ ተካፋይ ጻፍ። ከዚያ ላዕላዮቹን ደምር።

screens.title: Different denominators
paras: Example 1.16: 3/7 + 5/4. Follow Steps I to IV below with ▶.
screens.note: Always reduce your final answer to its lowest terms.

screens.title: Steps I–IV: 3/7 + 5/4
steps: Step I: make all denominators positive. 7 and 4 are already positive.
Step II: find the LCM of the denominators. The LCM of 7 and 4 is 28.
Step III: write equivalent fractions. 3/7 = (3 × 4)/(7 × 4) = 12/28 and 5/4 = (5 × 7)/(4 × 7) = 35/28.
Step IV: add the numerators and keep the denominator. 12 + 35 = 47.
So 3/7 + 5/4 = 47/28. 47 and 28 share no factor, so it is in lowest terms.

screens.title: Common denominator
defs: A denominator shared by two or more fractions.

screens.text: Common denominator: the LCM of 9, 6 and 4 is
screens.why:
Multiples of 9: 9, 18, 27, 36, …
18 is not divisible by 4. 27 is not divisible by 6 or 4.
36 ÷ 9 = 4, 36 ÷ 6 = 6 and 36 ÷ 4 = 9.
So the LCM is 36. (72 and 216 also work, but they are not the smallest.)

en.text: Both negative: add the absolute values and keep the minus sign. Different signs: subtract the smaller absolute value from the bigger, and take the sign of the number with the bigger absolute value.

am.text: ሁለቱም አሉታዊ ከሆኑ ፍጹም ዋጋዎቻቸውን ደምርና የመቀነስ ምልክቱን አቆይ። ምልክታቸው የተለያየ ከሆነ ትንሹን ፍጹም ዋጋ ከትልቁ ቀንስና የትልቁን ምልክት ውሰድ።

screens.title: Debts
screens.ask: Abebe owes 8 Birr. Then he owes 11 Birr more. Is the total a debt or a gain?
screens.after:
A debt is a negative number: −8, then −11 more.
−8 + (−11): both negative, so the total is negative.
Add the sizes: 8 + 11 = 19.
So Abebe has a debt of 19 Birr: −19.

screens.title: Rule 1: both negative
table: Put − in front of the sum.

screens.title: Rule 2: different signs
table: Take the sign of the number with the bigger absolute value.
Subtract the smaller absolute value from the bigger.

screens.title: Which rule do you use?
screens.text: Look at the signs. Both negative → Rule 1. Different signs → Rule 2.
items: Both negative: add the sizes, keep −. Answer −65/24.

screens.text: Sign rule for addition: −5/6 + 3/4. The sign of the answer is
screens.why:
The signs are different, so use Rule 2.
Compare the sizes: 5/6 = 10/12 and 3/4 = 9/12.
10/12 is bigger, so the answer takes the sign of −5/6.
The sign is −.

steps: The signs are different, so use Rule 2.
Absolute values: |−9/4| = 9/4 and |5/4| = 5/4.
9/4 is bigger, so the answer takes its sign: −.
Subtract the sizes: 9/4 − 5/4 = (9 − 5)/4 = 4/4.
4/4 = 1, so the answer is −1.

screens.why:
Different signs: use Rule 2.
Sizes with LCM 12: 5/6 = (5 × 2)/(6 × 2) = 10/12 and 3/4 = (3 × 3)/(4 × 3) = 9/12.
10/12 is bigger, so the sign is −.
Subtract the sizes: 10/12 − 9/12 = 1/12.
Answer: −1/12.

Both negative: use Rule 1. The answer is negative.
LCM of 6 and 8 is 24: 8/6 = (8 × 4)/(6 × 4) = 32/24 and 11/8 = (11 × 3)/(8 × 3) = 33/24.
Add the sizes: 32 + 33 = 65, so 65/24.
Put − in front: −65/24 = −2 17/24.
screens.worked:
Both are negative, so the answer is negative.
LCM of 6 and 8 is 24.
8/6 = (8 × 4)/(6 × 4) = 32/24 and 11/8 = (11 × 3)/(8 × 3) = 33/24.
32 + 33 = 65.
Answer: −65/24.

screens.ask: Add mixed numbers with different signs: −2 1/3 + 1 3/4 = ___
screens.why:
Change to improper fractions: −2 1/3 = −7/3 and 1 3/4 = 7/4.
LCM 12: −7/3 = −28/12 and 7/4 = 21/12.
Different signs: 28 > 21, so the sign is −.
Subtract the sizes: 28 − 21 = 7.
Answer: −7/12.
screens.clue: Change both to improper fractions, then use Rule 2.

en.text: Addition is commutative: the order does not matter. It is associative: the grouping does not matter. Adding 0 changes nothing. A number plus its opposite is 0.

am.text: መደመር የመለዋወጥ ባሕሪ አለው፤ ቅደም ተከተሉ ለውጥ አያመጣም። የመቧደን ባሕሪም አለው። 0 መደመር ምንም አይለውጥም። ቁጥርና ተቃራኒው ሲደመሩ 0 ይሆናል።

screens.title: Does order matter?
screens.after:
1/3 + 3/5 = 5/15 + 9/15 = 14/15.
3/5 + 1/3 = 9/15 + 5/15 = 14/15.
Both give 14/15. The order of adding does not matter.

screens.title: Properties of addition
paras: For any rational numbers a, b and c, four properties hold.
Tap each property below to see an example.

screens.title: Four properties of addition
items: a + b = b + a. Order does not matter: 1/3 + 3/5 = 3/5 + 1/3 = 14/15.
a + 0 = a = 0 + a. Adding 0 changes nothing: 2/7 + 0 = 2/7.
a + (−a) = 0. A number plus its opposite is 0: 3/4 + (−3/4) = 0.

steps: Way 1: add the first two first: 1/3 + 3/5.
Both ways give 63/30. Divide top and bottom by 3 (their GCF): 63/30 = 21/10.

screens.title: Key words
defs: Changing the order does not change the answer: a + b = b + a.
Changing the grouping does not change the answer.

screens.title: Properties of addition: match each property to its rule
screens.why:
Commutative: the order changes, a + b = b + a.
Associative: the grouping changes, a + (b + c) = (a + b) + c.
Property of 0: adding 0 changes nothing, a + 0 = a.
Opposites: a number plus its opposite is 0, a + (−a) = 0.

screens.ask: Add a fraction and a mixed number: 3/5 + 2 3/5 = ___
screens.why:
Change the mixed number: 2 3/5 = (2 × 5 + 3)/5 = 13/5.
Same denominator: add the tops, 3 + 13 = 16.
The sum is 16/5.
16/5 = 3 1/5 = 3.2.

screens.text: Property of opposites: true or false? 7/9 + (−7/9) = 0
screens.why:
7/9 and −7/9 are opposites.
Same denominator: 7 + (−7) = 0.
0/9 = 0.
True: a + (−a) = 0.

screens.ask: Add decimals in a word problem: Monday was 23.72 °C. Thursday was 3.23 °C more. Thursday = ___ °C
screens.why:
"More" means add: 23.72 + 3.23.
Line up the decimal points.
Hundredths: 2 + 3 = 5. Tenths: 7 + 2 = 9. Ones: 3 + 3 = 6. Tens: 2.
Thursday = 26.95 °C.

screens.text: Properties of addition: which grouping makes −5/7 + 3/4 + 5/7 easiest?
opts: None, they are all equally hard
screens.why:
Look for opposites: −5/7 and 5/7.
Swap the order (commutative) and group them (associative).
(−5/7 + 5/7) + 3/4 = 0 + 3/4.
0 + 3/4 = 3/4. No LCM needed!
screens.clue: Look for two numbers that are opposites.

items.ask: Add fractions with the same denominator: 13/5 + 21/5 = ___
items.why:
Same denominator 5: add the numerators.
13 + 21 = 34.
So 34/5.
34/5 = 6 4/5 = 6.8.

items.ask: Add decimals in a word problem: Monday 23.72 °C; Thursday 3.23 °C more. Thursday = ___ °C
items.why:
"More" means add.
23.72 + 3.23: line up the decimal points.
0.72 + 0.23 = 0.95 and 23 + 3 = 26.

test.why:
LCM of 10 and 5 is 10: 1/5 = 2/10.
Different signs: 7 > 2, so the sign is −.
Subtract the sizes: 7 − 2 = 5, so −5/10.
Simplify: −5/10 = −1/2.

Change to improper fractions: 1 1/2 = 3/2 and 2 2/3 = 8/3.

test.ask: Add three fractions with different denominators: 3/8 + 1/4 + 1/2 = ___

test.why:
Change: −1 1/2 = −3/2.
LCM of 2 and 3 is 6: −3/2 = −9/6 and 2/3 = 4/6.
Different signs: 9 > 4, so the sign is −.
9 − 4 = 5, so the answer is −5/6.
